استتبعت (form X)
# اِسْتَتْبَعْتُ (istatbaʕtu) /is.tat.baʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# اِسْتَتْبَعْتَ (istatbaʕta) /is.tat.baʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# اِسْتَتْبَعْتِ (istatbaʕti) /is.tat.baʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# اِسْتَتْبَعَتْ (istatbaʕat) /is.t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
